usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Gist holds contacts, so “Abandoned Checkout” can tag someone with “Add Tag to an Existing Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Tag to an Existing Contact” in Gist
bestTemplate.why: Tagging the shopper in Gist marks who left a cart, so follow-up can target them.

watchOut: “Add Tag to an Existing Contact” needs the contact to exist in Gist already.
